steps.title: Play first!
steps.text: Press Play. Move with WASD, jump with Space. The camera follows you. Reach the golden trophy!

steps.title: No movement code needed
steps.text: Select the Player: its CharacterController component already walks and jumps. Try a higher Jump Height or Speed in the Inspector.

steps.title: Lava
steps.text: Every object tagged 'lava' is a trigger. player.es checks the tag in on_trigger and respawns you at the last checkpoint.

steps.title: Moving parts
steps.text: Moving platforms use mover.es and the spinning bar uses spinner.es. They are Kinematic rigid bodies: scripts move them, and physics makes things standing on them ride along.

steps.title: Add a stage
steps.text: Select a Jump platform, press Ctrl+D and drag the copy with the gizmo. Duplicate a Lava brick to make new danger. Move the Finish Platform, Trophy and Finish further away to make room.

steps.title: Challenge
steps.text: Make a disappearing platform: a script that waits 1 second after the player touches it, then hides it and removes its BoxCollider with self.remove_component("BoxCollider").
